edges: s4 adjacent to every l_i and to no r_j or z
s1 adjacent to every r_j and to no l_i or z
family.chain_core: H=G[(L union {z}) union R] is a chain graph on bipartition (L union {z},R), with N(l_i)={r_1,...,r_i} and N(z)={r_1,...,r_{k-1}}.

P7_free_theorem.name: CROSSED_CHAIN_Xk_P7_FREE_V1
P7_free_theorem.statement: X_k is P7-free for every k>=3.
proof: The full graph is bipartite with sides A={s1,z} union L and B={s4} union R.

s1 is universal to the B side: it is adjacent to s4 and every r_j. Hence no induced P7 can contain s1, because a 7-vertex bipartite path contains at least three B-side vertices, and every nonconsecutive B-side vertex would be a chord to s1.
After deleting s1, H=G[L union R union {z}] is a chain graph and hence P5-free.
Therefore an induced P7 avoiding s1 must contain s4; otherwise it lies in H and is impossible.

If B is the minority side of such a P7, s4 would occupy an even path position. Both path-neighbors of s4 must lie in L, while both other A-side path vertices would have to be nonneighbors of s4. The only A-side nonneighbor is z, so two distinct such vertices cannot exist.
Thus B is the majority side and, up to path reversal, the only possible 7-role form is r_t-z-r_j-l_i-s4-l_h-r_c.
Chordlessness gives r_j-l_h nonedge => h<j; the path edge r_j-l_i gives j<=i; chordlessness gives l_i-r_c nonedge => i<c; the path edge l_h-r_c gives c<=h.
P7_free_theorem.authoritative_note: No older informal statement about a maximum number of H-vertices around s4 is used.

source_state.axiom_ii: S is connected by s1-s4; every L vertex misses s1, every R vertex misses s4, and z misses both, so no outside vertex is complete to S.
source_state.axiom_iii: z is exactly the nonfixed vertex anticomplete to S.
source_state.axiom_iv: Y0 is a singleton, so the no-mixing-on-Y0-edge condition is vacuous.
source_state.axiom_v: Every l_i sees only seed color 4 and has source list {1,2,3}; every r_j sees only seed color 1 and has source list {2,3,4}; z has [4].
source_state.axiom_vi: Y intersect N(Y0)={r_1,...,r_{k-1}}, and all such vertices have identical source 3-list {2,3,4}.

root_QALL.dynamic: L union R with chain edges l_i-r_j iff j<=i
root_QALL.connected: l_k is adjacent to every r_j, every l_i is adjacent to r_1, and [z] attaches to r_1,...,r_{k-1}; therefore Q_ALL is one connected block.

authorized_profile_family.profiles: For each F subseteq {2,...,k-1}, force l_i=1 exactly for i in F.
reachability: L is stable, so forced left vertices never conflict with each other.
Every l_i is nonadjacent to same-colored seed vertex s1 and remains adjacent only to seed color 4.
Forcing l_i=1 adds no new seed-color effect to any r_j, because every r_j already sees color 1 from s1.
Thus source lists of all still-live vertices remain unchanged and no Z0/Z1 promotion occurs.
A complete extension exists for every F: color every L vertex 1, every R vertex 4, and z color 2.

profile_injection.role_marking: L and R are canonically distinguished by their source/fixed-color masks: L has seed-color mask {4}, R has seed-color mask {1}.
profile_injection.degree_signature: Each surviving l_i has exactly i neighbors in R.
profile_injection.recovery: The set of surviving L-to-R degrees equals {i in {1,...,k}: i notin F}; l_1 and l_k always remain.
profile_injection.conclusion: Different F yield pairwise distinct canonical effect profiles even after forcing-order confluence and new-seed identity erasure.
profile_injection.count: 2^(k-2), exponential in the connected Q_ALL block size Theta(k).

structural_carrier.name: XK_BOUNDED4_PERMUTATION_LIST_CARRIER_V1
structural_carrier.static: The indexed original chain graph H on L union {z} versus R, equivalently a permutation-graph representation/order.
dynamic_per_original_vertex: 4-bit current exact list A(v) when ACTIVE
structural_carrier.size: Polynomial; O(k) status/list words with the canonical chain ordering, or polynomial under explicit graph storage.
closure_under_updates: Authorized forcing only fixes vertices and deletes their colors from neighboring active lists.
B2B1 may additionally delete independently solved components and store reconstruction receipts.
The remaining active graph is always an induced subgraph of the original chain graph H.
Induced subgraphs of a chain graph are chain graphs, hence permutation graphs.
structural_carrier.decision_backend: Enright-Stewart-Tardos: List Coloring is polynomial on permutation graphs when the total number of colors is bounded. Here the total palette is fixed [4].
structural_carrier.R1: Temporarily set A(u)={c} and run bounded-4 permutation-graph List Coloring on the active graph.
structural_carrier.R2: For a baseline nonedge uv, temporarily set A(u)=A(v)={c} and run the same bounded-4 List Coloring backend.
structural_carrier.constructive_reconstruction: Use self-reduction: for each active vertex try at most four singleton-list choices, retaining a choice whose decision instance remains YES. At most O(4n) decision calls.
structural_carrier.update: After a successful force, persist the fixed assignment, propagate color deletions to active lists, and invoke the sealed B2B1 canonical-return bookkeeping as required.
structural_carrier.reconstruction: Combine fixed assignments, the self-reduced active-chain coloring, and independent DELETED receipts.
structural_carrier.lifecycle: Polynomial storage, query, update and reconstruction.

source_backend_audit.paper: Enright, Stewart, Tardos (2014), On List Coloring and List Homomorphism of Permutation and Interval Graphs
source_backend_audit.claim_used: Polynomial List Coloring on permutation graphs with bounded total number of colors.
source_backend_audit.class_bridge: Chain graphs are a subclass of bipartite permutation graphs/permutation graphs.
source_backend_audit.generic_solver_firewall: No generic P7 List-4 or generic precoloring solver is inferred.

verdict.interpretation: Exponential profile multiplicity, connected Q_ALL, absence of a global missing color, and genuine all-four-color future activity are still not hardness proxies.
